title: Angry Florida Man Did This to Walmart Employee
description:
Bodycam footage shows an unhappy Florida man being confronted by deputies after a Walmart employee said he spit in her face. The Flagler County Sheriff’s Office said Channing Cooks claimed he unintentionally sneezed in the woman’s face. The worker said he actually spat in her face and repeatedly yelled, “I have a cold!” Watch what happened when deputies caught up with the angry Florida man on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
